items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I played for Bobby Vernon or...

ctx.x: Well, at Basin Street East what did you do? Accompany singers who came in and...?

No, I just played intermission piano. I played for some acts. A comedian I played for, Rich Little; I played for Bobby Vernon or... You know, when they didn't have music or anything, I would play for them. And it became a sort of a dependable engagement.
